{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# QA orders have revenue = 999999.99, refunded orders have status == 'refunded'
real_completed = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Compute mean revenue for loyal customers in completed, real orders
mean_revenue = real_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print("Number of loyal, completed, real orders:", len(real_completed))
print("Mean revenue (cleaned, filtered):")
print(mean_revenue)"}
